name: Gulf Stones SAOG
hq: Post Box 47, Sohar Industrial Estate, Postal Code 327, Sultanate of Oman
description: Gulf Stones Company SAOG, founded in March 1999 in Sohar Industrial Estate and listed in January 2002, operated in Oman's mining and engineered stone manufacturing sector with institutional backing from Arab Mining Company and Gulf Investment Corporation. The company is placed on the MSX Under_Monitoring Market following severe reporting and governance disruptions, with its latest MSX disclosures dating to mid-2023 covering delayed financial statements, board member resignations, and the departure of its General Manager. Its legacy corporate website is no longer active under company control, and its 20.00 million shares (OMR 2.00 million paid-up capital, 69 shareholders) currently reflect zero active market capitalization.
